outliers_methodology: A row is listed here only if (a) its unit_type differs from its collection's stated default/law per book_strategy Prov.md §6, AND (b) its own prose (rationale/device_notes/rejected_alternative) contains no explicit self-referential statement naming the departure from that collection default, AND (c) it does not fall inside a strategy-pre-licensed exception zone (e.g. Agur 30:1-9). Rows meeting (a) but not (b)/(c) are listed separately under disclosed_deviations for full evidence preservation. C1's own strategy rule (§6 first bullet) is non-exclusive (no explicit 'default + evidenced exception' structure like C2/C3/C5/C6 carry), so its 5 listed rows are a softer finding than the C6 rows.
